accepted: Hosanna to the Son of David

clues.text: As Jesus rode into Jerusalem, the crowds ahead of Him and behind Him shouted this to the Son of David.
Children shouted this in the temple courts, and the chief priests and scribes grew indignant.
On the road into Jerusalem, people blessed the coming kingdom of David and cried this "in the highest."
Holding palm branches, a crowd went out to meet Jesus shouting this, and then "Blessed is the King of Israel!"
As Jesus came toward Jerusalem, people shouted this just before "Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!"
Angry leaders asked Jesus if He heard the children in the temple; He answered that God ordained praise from infants.
A large crowd at the feast heard Jesus was coming to Jerusalem and went out to meet Him shouting this.
